title: Test claim handoffs in human and JSON CLI output
description: Add focused CLI tests for task next and task start when TaskView contains handoffs. Human task output should add a handoffs section with ID/scope/author/time/message only when records exist; JSON should expose the additive handoffs array without wrapping or changing existing task fields. Confirm no-handoff output remains byte-compatible with prior behavior and regular task show/list do not gain attached records.
